#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cstring>
#include <stdexcept>

using namespace std;

const int MOD = 1000000007;

class DNekoIPrank {
public:
    class Solve {
    public:
        int solve(int n) {
            int maxDepth = 2 * n;
            vector<vector<vector<int>>> dp(maxDepth + 1, 
                                           vector<vector<int>>(maxDepth + 1, vector<int>(2, 0)));
            
            dp[0][0][0] = 1;
            
            for (int depth = 1; depth <= maxDepth; depth++) {
                for (int opened = depth & 1; opened <= depth; opened += 2) {
                    if (opened - 1 >= 0) {
                        dp[depth][opened][0] = (dp[depth][opened][0] + dp[depth - 1][opened - 1][1]) % MOD;
                        dp[depth][opened][1] = (dp[depth][opened][1] + dp[depth - 1][opened - 1][0]) % MOD;
                    }
                    if (opened + 1 <= maxDepth) {
                        dp[depth][opened][0] = (dp[depth][opened][0] + dp[depth - 1][opened + 1][1]) % MOD;
                        dp[depth][opened][1] = (dp[depth][opened][1] + dp[depth - 1][opened + 1][0]) % MOD;
                    }
                    dp[depth][opened][0] = (dp[depth][opened][0] + 1) % MOD;
                    dp[depth][opened][1] %= MOD;
                }
            }
            
            return dp[maxDepth][0][1];
        }
    };

    void solve(int testNumber, int n, ostream& out) {
        int ans = Solve().solve(n);
        out << ans;
    }
};

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    
    DNekoIPrank solver;
    solver.solve(1, n, cout);
    
    return 0;
}
